{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the last (highest sample_seq)
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_baseline"}
